files.description: Architecture, multi-module layout, the Provider/Client contract, optional capability interfaces, conventions, and the per-module release process.
Contribution workflow, prerequisites, and how go.work wires the modules together for local development.
Core contract: the Provider interface, Client, the sentinel error set, the DeliveryStatus enum, and the WebhookParser func type that providers implement.
Provider-agnostic helpers: E.164 validation/normalization, GSM 03.38 vs UCS-2 segment counting, MultiProvider, and message constructors.
